stb_vorbis v1.25, single-file Ogg Vorbis decoder.
Source: https://github.com/nothings/stb (stb_vorbis.c)
Unmodified stb_vorbis.c. Dual MIT/Unlicense; both license texts are included at the end of the file.
Used by the Windows music module for .ogg playback, because Media Foundation has no
in-box Vorbis decoder that a classic Win32 process can reach.
